links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-estimated suicidality severity ratings in simulated MADRS assessments
links.effect: 30% of maximum suicide risk ratings were underestimated by two or more severity levels; most configurations underestimated severe presentations.
links.quote: Item-level analysis revealed excellent accuracy for concrete symptoms (Inner Tension r=0.91, Reduced Sleep r=0.88) but with concerning underestimation of severe suicidality: 30% of maximum suicide risk ratings were underestimated by two or more severity levels.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the capabilities, biases, and safety limitations (e.g., underestimating severe suicidality) of LLMs in simulated patient and clinician MADRS assessment interactions, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
